board: Joy-IT SensorKit KY-026 flame sensor module (4-pin header printed AO, G, +, DO)
reason: The check passed on the first run for ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator and circuit board. AO is modelled as a voltage that falls as the flame gets stronger (Joy-IT: the signal is inverted), and DO as the LM393 output, HIGH on flame as Joy-IT documents. The driver has active_high=False for clones whose DO goes LOW on flame.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/files/files/sensors/KY-026/KY-026.png (board photo, silkscreen AO, G, +, DO) and https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/en/sensors/ky-026
